newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Crowley, La..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Crowley, La..

text.p: Street Improvement Bonds,Street Improvement Bonds, Series ST-1997A of the Series 1997B of the
City of Crowley, City of Crowley,
State of Louisiana State of Louisiana

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Mayor and Board of Aldermen of the City of Crowley, Parish of Acadia, State of Louisiana, will receive sealed bids for the purchase of (i) $4,830,000 of Street Improvement Bonds, Series ST-1997A of the Issuer (the Sales Tax Bonds''), and (ii) $4,040,000 of General Obligation Street Improvement Bonds, Series 1997B of the Issuer (the General Obligation Bonds
Tax Bonds '' and General Obligation Bonds'' being
meeting place, the City Hall, 426 North Avenue F, Crowley, Louisiana, until SEVEN O'CLOCK (7:00) P.M., DAYLIGHT SAVING TIME, on TUESDAY, APRIL 15, 1997.

The Bonds will be in fully registered form, will be dated June 1, 1997, will be in the denomination of $5,000 each or any integral multiple thereof for any single maturity, will bear interest from date thereof or the most recent interest payment date to which interest has been paid or duly provided for at a rate or rates not exceeding seven percent (7%) per annum on any Bond in any interest payment period, said interest to be payable December 1, 1997 and
semiannually thereafter on June 1 and December 1 of each year. The Bonds of each issue will be numbered from R-1 upward and will mature serially on June 1 of each year as follows, to-wit:

Those Bonds of each series maturing June 1, 2008 and thereafter will be callable for redemption by the Issuer in full at any time on or after June 1, 2007, as more fully described in the Official Notice of Sale. For information relative to the Bonds and not contained in the Summary Notice of Bond Sale or for copies of the Preliminary Official Statement, contact Mayor Robert L. Istre, Post Office Box 1463, Crowley, Louisiana 70527, or

Thomas K. Regan, City Attorney, 525 West Court Ci Crowley, Louisiana 70526, Phone: 318-783-7141, or Benton, Benton & Benton, P.L.C., 601 St. Ferdinand Street, Baton Rouge, Louisiana 70802, Phone: 504-343-6611, Bond Counsel. THUS DONE AND SIGNED at Crowley, Louisiana, on this, the 28th day of January, 1997.
